arStrings.szText:
Gain {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage to a set of damage types for {c_number}[Affix."Static_Value_0"]{/c} seconds alternating randomly between {c_number}2{/c} sets: 
{icon:bullet,1.2}Fire, Lightning, Holy, and Physical. 
{icon:bullet,1.2}Cold, Poison, and Shadow.

Fate can favor you granting the same bonus more than once, stacking up to {c_number}[Affix."Static_Value_1"]{/c} times. At Maximum, it's your lucky day!
Randomly alternate {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage between Fire, Lightning, and Physical, or Cold, Poison, and Shadow. This bonus can stack.
